meta.name: resume-forge
meta.description: Use when creating, sourcing, or refining resume problem-solving material — building compound scenarios, developing problem definitions, crafting solution strategies, or iterating entries until examiner approval. Triggers on 이력서 재료/소재, 문제 상황 만들기, 시나리오 작성, compound scenario, 이력서 항목 작성

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 优化简历中的问题解决案例
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用具体案例突出你的问题解决能力
copy.tagline_en: Refine problem-solving examples in your resume
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to highlight problem-solving skills with concrete examples in your resume

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你创建或完善简历中的问题解决条目。它会引导你挖掘经历、定义问题场景，并分两个循环（问题定义与完整条目）逐步优化，直到通过审核。
howto.when: 当你提到“이력서 재료”、“문제 상황 만들기”、“compound scenario”等关键词，或要求创建、完善简历条目时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个解决分布式系统故障的场景。
say.note: Claude 会引导你提供细节，然后起草问题定义。

say.text: 这个问题的因果关系不够清晰，帮我改进。
say.note: Claude 会重新审查问题定义并建议修改。

say.text: 完善我关于性能优化的简历条目。
say.note: Claude 会进入循环2，补充解决方案和结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you create or refine problem-solving entries for your resume. It guides you through source mining, defines problem scenarios, and iterates through two feedback loops (problem definition and full entry) until examiner approval.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like '이력서 재료', '문제 상황 만들기', 'compound scenario', or ask to create/refine resume entries.

say_en.text: Help me write a scenario about solving a distributed system failure.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to provide details and draft a problem definition.

say_en.text: The causal relationship in this problem is unclear, improve it.
say_en.note: Claude will review and suggest modifications to the problem definition.

say_en.text: Refine my resume entry about performance optimization.
say_en.note: Claude will enter Loop 2 to add solution strategy and results.
